svg.title: Proof of Progress: a data-tile illustration
svg.desc: 967 selected claims: 841 Difficult, 107 Superhuman and 19 Superhuman — tentative AI-frontier placement. Adjacent equal-width 3-month periods from Apr 25 to Sept 26; only empty leading/trailing periods are omitted. Interior zero months remain in their period totals. Fixed overview using the dashboard default best-current assessment, including all review and verification states. Blue includes all Difficult estimates; purple is best-estimate Superhuman with a reported material AI contribution; pale purple is tentative AI-frontier placement. Stack height is proportional to claim count on one shared scale; square tiles are a texture, not individual claims. No axes or visible labels are drawn. Each claim counts once using its likely category; confidence in the assessment is separate from proof verification. Latest month may be partial, so the latest period is observed-to-date, not extrapolated. Monthly detail remains in the dashboard.
